The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the relationships are inferred through a series of targets, and the direct interaction between Azadirachtin Q and the transporter remains unconfirmed. The mechanism involves a chain of molecular interactions, but the exact nature of the interaction between Azadirachtin Q and the transporter is not fully elucidated.
